name: TRMNL client (1-bit PNG)
description: Composition PNG fitted to the device's panel size, then quantised to 1-bit black/white with the selected dither. Output is a 1-bit greyscale PNG that the KOReader trmnl-display plugin (and native TRMNL hardware) paints directly. Per-device picture quality (dither / contrast) lives on the device card and tunes the output for the specific panel, Kindle Paperwhite, native TRMNL panel, ESP32 SPI-attached, etc.

settings.name: contrast
settings.label: Pre-dither contrast
settings.help: Push midtones toward black or white before the dither pass. 1.0 leaves the image alone; > 1.0 deepens contrast (good for photos with grey skies); < 1.0 softens (good for text-heavy dashboards).
